benchmark: BEAM 100K (20 conversations, 400 questions, 10 question types x 2 per conversation)
answer_prompt: AMB's BEAM prompt (dataset.build_rag_prompt), default model settings
judge: AMB's BEAM scorer (dataset.score_result), continuous score in [0, 1]
token_counting: tiktoken cl100k_base over the exact memory text given to the answer model

setups.assertion: Assertion's whole memory for the conversation, as an indented outline. Up to 3 earlier (superseded) facts most similar to the question (cosine >= 0.60) are appended under an EARLIER STATES heading. 3 answering runs.
setups.hindsight: Hindsight's own retrieved context, taken unchanged from its published AMB BEAM 100K results, answered and judged by the same model, prompt and judge as Assertion. 3 answering runs.

runs_note: Each run re-answers and re-judges every question from the same memory text. Memory was captured once per conversation for each system.
